definitions.explanation: A feeling of anger or irritation, often simmering or building up rather than an explosive outburst. Derived from the verb 腹立つ (to get angry).

examples.japanese: {腹立|はらだ}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{腹立|はらだ}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I felt annoyed by his attitude.

examples.japanese: ⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}られて→破る：02321_yaburu⟧、{腹立|はらだ}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{収|おさ}まらなかった→収まる：11858_osamaru⟧。
examples.english: Having had promises broken repeatedly, my anger would not subside.

notes:
The noun form of ⟦{腹|はら}が{立|た}つ→腹が立つ：06886_haragatatsu⟧ (to get angry, literally 'the belly rises'). Expresses anger that is felt internally, often building or simmering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腹立|はらだ}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧: to feel irritation/anger
- {腹立|はらだ}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel annoyed
- {腹立|はらだ}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{収|おさ}まらない→収まる：11858_osamaru⟧: anger won't subside
- {腹立|はらだ}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧: to hold back one's anger
- {腹立|はらだ}ちまぎれ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: out of spite; in a fit of anger

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧: anger, wrath — stronger and more intense than {腹立|はらだ}ち
- ⟦{苛立|いらだ}ち→苛立ち：05815_iradachi⟧: irritation, frustration — focuses on restless, fidgety irritation
- ⟦{立腹|りっぷく}→立腹：20187_rippuku⟧: anger, indignation — more formal synonym; same kanji in different order
- ⟦{憤|いきどお}り→憤り：10890_ikidoori⟧: indignation, resentment — anger at something unjust

ETYMOLOGY:
From the Japanese body metaphor where the ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧ (belly/gut) is the seat of emotions. When one is angry, the belly 'rises' (⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧).
